name: Gait Recognition in the Wild Benchmark
description: A large-scale in-the-wild dataset and evaluation protocol for gait recognition, accompanied by NAS-based baseline results.
reputation: Well-regarded within the gait-recognition research community as a challenging in-the-wild benchmark with growing citations and use.
notes: Non-LLM, vision-only benchmark. Large-scale and challenging due to occlusion, pose and view variability; contains identifiable gait data raising privacy considerations.
